## History

Stella Maynard attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) and worked as a schoolteacher before entering [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). After Anne's initial period of teaching, Stella received a letter from her sharing humorous anecdotes about her students. During her college years, Stella lived at Patty's Place with her friends, chatting about household matters and simple living alongside [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md). In her final year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), she reminisced with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) over old [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) manuscripts during a rainy evening of studying. Following final examinations, Stella and her housemates gathered to reflect on the life lessons and common sense they gained over their four years at college before packing up to leave Patty's Place after graduation.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 ch.Davy P0](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0000), +15 more_

## Quotes

> "I love Anne and I like Roy. Everybody says she is making a brilliant match, and even Mrs. Gardner thinks her charming now. It all sounds as if it were made in heaven, but I have my doubts. Make the most of that, Aunt Jamesina."
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Dawn P16](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0016)

> “Well, I don’t know how he and the Sarah-cat will ever make out to live together,” said Stella pesimistically. “Cat-fights in the orchard o’nights are bad enough. But cat-fights here in the livingroom are unthinkable.”
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051)

> "I was afraid they’d come back. And then our jolly little nest here would be broken up—and we poor callow nestlings thrown out on the cruel world of boardinghouses again."
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Confidences P10](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0010)

> "Nothing seems worthwhile. My very thoughts are old. I’ve thought them all before. What is the use of living after all, Anne?"
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Opens P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031)

> "Oh, my mind agrees with you, Anne. But my soul remains doleful and uninspired. I’m always grubby and dingy on rainy nights."
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Opens P35](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0035)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stella-maynard.md)

Stella and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) became close friends while attending Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) together. They later set up house as college companions at Patty's Place alongside their friends and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), sharing domestic duties, academic prep, and lighthearted conversations. During quiet moments, such as rainy study sessions, the two reminisce over old [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) writings and support each other's creative pursuits.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), +24 more_

- Friend of — close friend at Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021), [v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), +2 more</sub>

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/phil-gordon--stella-maynard.md)

Stella and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) share a friendship as housemates living together at Patty's Place during their time at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). They regularly exchange casual advice and banter over practical household matters, such as rising prices and simple living, as well as their personal lives and suitors. Through their shared final years at college, they maintain a warm, lighthearted dynamic within their group.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), +21 more_

- Friend of — housemates and friends who give each other advice (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Charming P18](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0018)</sub>

### [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/priscilla-grant--stella-maynard.md)

Stella and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) first established their friendship as chums at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Their bond continues through their higher education as housemates at Patty's Place, where they study for examinations and manage a home together alongside their friends. Upon finishing their college years, they reflect together on the common sense and practical life lessons gained alongside their studies.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), +22 more_

- Friend of — chums at Queen's Academy (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007)</sub>
